text: **JSONL remains the truth** — append-only, crash-safe, diffable. - **SQLite + FTS5 is the derived index** — `.ai/harpp/experience.db`, deletable and rebuildable from the sources at any time, so it can never become a second source of divergent truth. - **The swap point is two functions** (`cmd_index` / `cmd_search`). Callers never write SQL, so moving to PostgreSQL or MySQL changes no interface and no record.
